stage: M56 frozen native availability and common-target comparison; no fitting
selection: Only passing family/format under predeclared training gate; all four pairs/eight endpoints including native errors retained.
site: Native MLP1 final-position product write, excluding Down bias; zero-based layer1.
target_directions: For each recipient, delta is opposite endpoint donor final-position native product write minus recipient final-position product write. Add delta at recipient final position only. Also use same-object explicit-QA donor as a format-change diagnostic, and identity zero delta. Final-position alignment is explicit and allows unequal prompt lengths; it is not full-sequence semantic alignment.
semantics: Task donor may carry nuisance object/context changes. QA donor changes prompt format and may alter behavior; do not assume invariance or describe it as a pure nuisance control.
native_metrics: Full-vocabulary native probability weighted squared final logprob response energy
candidate_models: All18 M37 initial/control/joint scalar,block,shared states from joint_shared_models.json; exact same saved native deltas applied to each reconstructed MLP1 baseline as M37. No candidate-specific target or recipient magnitude oracle.
candidate_metrics: Native probability weighted response prediction error and margin-response error, relative to native target energy. Retain zeros; report raw energies, per-input values, ordinary-output fidelity and actual active cost.
scope: Training-family feasibility/development benchmark, not heldout transfer or new-task discovery. External write perturbation response, not proof of native neuron redundancy.
stop: Complete all8recipients×3donorconditions and all18frozen candidate comparisons, audit, then report regardless of signs. No amplitude/layer/prompt/candidate search. Subsequent fitting requires separately frozen dataset/compute-matched control and preserved whole-family holdouts.
